ModMetaData.name: Society: Guards
ModMetaData.author: Cashew
ModMetaData.description:
Part of the Society Suite, but works on its own.
Adds a Guard work type. Guards hold guard posts or walk patrol routes, and they fight hostiles that come near.
- Guard posts and patrol spots in four colors (red, blue, green, yellow), found under Architect > Security. - Guard posts can be rotated; the guard faces the arrow's direction. - Patrol spots of one color form a route. Reorder it from the spot's buttons, and choose loop or back-and-forth. - The Guards tab lists your guards. Use it to assign each one to a post color or a patrol route, and to show or hide all spots.
Guarding counts as work, so set its priority in the Work tab (or in the Guards tab) and schedule guards' work hours. Pawns who can't do violence can't guard.
